title: Nifty reclaims 23,000 on an IT rally, but two of every three stocks fell
short: Nifty back above 23,000 on IT rally; smallcaps slide 1.85%
dek: Infosys, Trent and IndiGo lifted the benchmarks for a second straight day. Underneath, midcaps and smallcaps fell and decliners outnumbered gainers more than two to one.
card: Nifty +116.35 at 23,053.10, Sensex +308.49 at 74,459.53. Nifty IT +2.32%, but Smallcap 100 −1.85% and Bank Nifty −0.41%.
sources: HDFC Sky: Market close report, 30 October 2026
